statement: Exposing aged mice to a young systemic environment by parabiosis restored the regenerative capacity of aged muscle and liver progenitor cells, and young plasma improved hippocampal plasticity and cognitive function in aged mice.

measurement.assay: progenitor regenerative capacity; hippocampal plasticity and behaviour
measurement.effect: restored regenerative capacity; improved cognitive measures

limitations: parabiosis shares organs and physiology, not only plasma

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
